description: Purchasing power parity converter — Convert an amount (salary, price, budget) between countries by purchasing power parity, next to the market exchange rate. Uses World Bank PPP conversion factors (private consumption, falling back to GDP PPP) and official exchange rates for the latest year both countries report → PPP-equivalent amount in the destination currency, market-rate equivalent, international dollars, price level index (US=100) for each country and a plain-English interpretation. Params: amount= (in the from-country's local currency), from= and to= (ISO 2/3-letter code like US, DE, IND, or a country name). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: econ_ppp
